description: Source code for testing and intercepting Windows CryptoAPI certificate store functions, specifically related to root certificates, including injection of custom store provider functions and certificate management.

classes.name: CryptoAPIInjector
classes.description: Handles injection of custom store provider functions into Windows CryptoAPI to intercept certificate store operations.

methods.name: InterceptedOpenStoreW
methods.description: Intercepts calls to CertOpenStore for system store, injecting test root certificates.

methods.name: CryptoAPIInjector()
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the interception of CryptoAPI store functions.

methods.name: ~CryptoAPIInjector()
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the injected function.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::AddImpl
methods.description: Adds a certificate to the test root store, ensuring interception is active.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::ClearImpl
methods.description: Clears all certificates from the test root store.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::GetChainEngine
methods.description: Returns a certificate chain engine configured with current root certificates.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::Init
methods.description: Initializes the test root certificate store.
